records.name: Animal
records.core_function: Normal-led creature; half ordinary supply use; reduced armless siege value except monkeys
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Animal-specific control and awe; siege contribution

records.name: Magic Being
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Leader loss; magic-being targeting; undead-plus-magic uses undead leadership

records.name: Mindless
records.core_function: Morale 50 under control; many mind effects fail
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Cannot mix with non-mindless; dissolves without suitable leader

records.name: Undead
records.core_function: Requires undead leadership; disease immune; banishable
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Ordinary healing restrictions; anti-undead effects; harmful living mix

records.name: Demon
records.core_function: Requires undead leadership; disease immune; banishable
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Demon-specific effects; do not infer undead or elemental traits

records.name: Inanimate or Lifeless
records.core_function: Nonliving body with disease, life-drain, and ordinary-healing immunities
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Needs Reconstruction or specialised repair; class wording is object-specific

records.name: Spiritform
records.core_function: Spirit body; transformation, disease, and ordinary-healing immunity
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Not identical to Ethereal; specialised spirit effects remain

records.name: Plant
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Does not imply Mindless, Inanimate, or resistances

records.name: Stone Being
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Do not infer Inanimate unless separately present

records.name: Illusion
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Distinct from Glamour, Invisibility, and Ethereal

records.name: Horror
records.core_function: Lesser, Greater, or Doom Horror category
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Horror Mark does not grant this class

records.name: Sacred
records.core_function: Eligible for blessing and Holy recruitment rules
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Must be blessed; Incarnate effects require proper god state

records.name: Cold Blooded
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Cold scales and chill pressure; verify exact current modifier

records.name: Aquatic
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Usually land-incompatible without another form or effect

records.name: Amphibian
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Underwater weapons, mounts, and spells still matter

records.name: Poor Amphibian
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Penalties can make nominal access tactically poor

records.name: Flying
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Storms, retreat routes, squad compatibility, anti-flyer screens

records.name: Floating
records.core_function: Passes relevant ground or terrain constraints
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Not full flight; mount interaction is separate

records.name: Storm Immunity
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Does not grant flight by itself

records.name: Terrain Survival
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: One incompatible army member can constrain route

records.name: Sailing
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Capacity, passenger size, route, and no underwater stay

records.name: Teleport
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Unteleportable, legality, timing, and retreat; 6.35 siege exception is narrow

records.name: Immobile
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Requires summons, remote influence, or special movement

records.name: Magic Leadership
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Capacity and leader survival; does not replace undead precedence

records.name: Undead Leadership
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Capacity and leader survival; anti-leader attacks

records.name: Standard
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Only best Standard in squad applies

records.name: Inspirational
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Can be negative; commander-bound rather than squad item

records.name: Taskmaster
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Valuable only with matching followers

records.name: Beast Master
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Animal-specific; ordinary roster gains little

records.name: Formation Fighter
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Needs formation-wide support; crowding and area effects remain

records.name: Undisciplined
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Reduces script control; separate from low morale

records.name: Bodyguard
records.core_function: Chance for guards to join assassination defence
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Not certainty; current exploit fixed in 6.35

records.name: Stealthy
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Patrol contest, composition, terrain, and size

records.name: Spy
records.core_function: Enables intelligence and covert unrest work
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Patrols and order-specific exposure

records.name: Assassin
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Bodyguards, Warning, target restrictions, failure battle

records.name: Seduction family
records.core_function: Attempts special recruitment, corruption, or assassination outcomes
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Sex, target, patience, location, checks, and failure differ by ability

records.name: Glamour
records.core_function: Mirror images in battle; hidden in friendly provinces
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Images can be stripped; specialised sight; not Illusion

records.name: Invisibility or Unseen
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Exact perception counter is ability-specific

records.name: Darkvision
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Percentage or value matters; does not answer every concealment

records.name: Spirit Sight
records.core_function: Detects relevant spiritual or ethereal targets
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Not a universal True Sight substitute

records.name: True Sight
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Check exact effect; darkness may remain separate

records.name: Elemental Resistance
records.core_function: Reduces matching fire, cold, shock, poison, or acid pressure
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Secondary effects and other damage types can bypass the plan

records.name: Physical Resistance
records.core_function: Reduces matching pierce, slash, or blunt damage
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Wrong weapon type bypasses; exact layer in Book IV

records.name: Air Shield
records.core_function: Reduces chance of relevant missiles hitting
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Spells and nonmissile delivery; exact percentage

records.name: Ethereal
records.core_function: 75 percent of nonmagical strikes miss; passes fort walls
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Magical attacks; other layers still apply

records.name: Twist Fate
records.core_function: Negates a qualifying damaging event, then ends
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Multiple attacks or prior expendable hit

records.name: Luck
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: High attack volume; verify interaction order

records.name: Regeneration
records.core_function: Heals exact percentage of maximum HP per round and reduces affliction risk
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Burst damage, disablement, inanimate immunity, soul effects

records.name: Reconstruction
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Verify percentage and body eligibility

records.name: Undead Regeneration
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Not every undead has it; burst and control remain

records.name: Reinvigoration
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Cannot restore actions already lost; short fights may not use it

records.name: Recuperation
records.core_function: Attempts to heal eligible battle afflictions over months
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Excludes old age; class and affliction difficulty restrictions

records.name: Healer
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Body and affliction eligibility; healer value and difficulty

records.name: Immortality
records.core_function: Returns after death under defined conditions
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Delay, dominion, soul destruction, position, and lost battle

records.name: Awe
records.core_function: Forces attacker morale check against 10 plus Awe
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Morale, immunity, missiles, spells, rapid removal

records.name: Sun Awe
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Disabled underground or in darkness

records.name: Fear
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Leadership, morale, mindless, range, source removal; exact current procedure in Book IV

records.name: Heat or Chill Aura
records.core_function: Applies local fatigue and elemental pressure
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Matching resistance, scales, spacing, range

records.name: Poison Cloud
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Poison resistance, spacing, ranged removal

records.name: Disease or Plague Aura
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Disease Resistance, separation, cure capacity

records.name: Sleep Aura
records.core_function: Causes nearby units to become unconscious
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Resistance or immunity, range, rapid removal

records.name: Fire Shield
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Fire resistance, range, long weapons, disposable attacks

records.name: Damage Reversal
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Exact trigger and resistance; nonqualifying attacks

records.name: Blood Vengeance
records.core_function: Punishes damage through a resistance interaction
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Magic Resistance, attack selection, ranged or disposable delivery

records.name: Petrification
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Magic Resistance, immunity, noncontact delivery

records.name: Ambidextrous
records.core_function: Reduces multiweapon attack penalty by value
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Does not remove extra weapon encumbrance

records.name: Berserker
records.core_function: Wounded morale check can enter no-rout combat state with bonuses
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Loss of control; unconsciousness ends current state

records.name: Trample
records.core_function: Displaces smaller units and deals size-based armour-piercing damage
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Large targets, fatigue, formation, space, ranged disablement

records.name: Swallow or Digest
records.core_function: Removes and damages eligible target inside swallower
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Size restriction; kill or disable swallower; blocks many life-saving effects

records.name: Life Drain
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Lifeless targets; range; resistance; rapid killing

records.name: Seasonal Power
records.core_function: Changes attributes in a matching season
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Predictable weak months; year-turn or form changes

records.name: Scale Power
records.core_function: Changes attributes in matching scales or environment
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Change scales, light, storm, or battlefield location

records.name: Need Not Eat
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Does not imply disease, undead, or inanimate status

records.name: Supply Bonus
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Value realised only where supply is binding

records.name: Siege or Patrol Bonus
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: No value while action is unused; exact formula elsewhere

records.name: Research Bonus
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Commander-turn opportunity cost

records.name: Forge Bonus
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Item and path eligibility and rounding; only while forging

records.name: Innate Spellcaster
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Current 6.35 script fix; fatigue and unconsciousness still matter

records.name: Summoner or Retinue
records.core_function: Creates or restores followers on a trigger or schedule
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Leadership, cap, persistence, and created class

records.name: Experience
records.core_function: Adds star packages at 15, 50, 100, 200, and 400 XP
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Role-specific value; official and community cumulative HP discrepancy

records.name: Heroic Ability
records.core_function: Hall-of-Fame commander gains a growing special trait
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Exact formula and rarity are community-derived and version-sensitive

records.name: Affliction
records.core_function: Lasting injury with body-part and difficulty rules
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Correct healer and body eligibility; role can be lost

records.name: Disease
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Disease Resistance, immunity, Disease Healer; distinct from old age

records.name: Curse
records.core_function: Persistent increased misfortune and affliction exposure
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Not ordinarily removable; avoid contamination

records.name: Horror Mark
records.core_function: Hidden stacked severity and monthly horror-attack chance
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Not ordinary affliction; conceal, protect, or accept long risk

records.name: Insanity
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Redundancy and noncritical assignments

records.name: Old Age
records.core_function: Age-driven deterioration beyond body-adjusted maximum age
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Recuperation does not heal age afflictions

records.name: Poison
records.core_function: Delayed accumulating damage; also reduces Precision since 6.30
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Poison resistance, recovery, battle duration

records.name: Burning, Bleeding, or Frozen
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Relevant immunity or resistance; Spiritform protected in 6.30

records.name: Stun, Paralysis, or Sleep
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Resistance, immunity, recovery time, source removal

records.name: Entanglement
records.core_function: Prevents movement or action until escape
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Strength or ability-specific escape; ranged support

records.name: Charm or Enslave
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Magic Resistance, immunity, range, killing target or caster

records.name: Transformation
records.principal_caveat_or_counter: Polyimmune, targeting immunity, form-specific loss
